primitives.note: Inner Flame/Soulflare impact damage and Focused Resolve initial damage each fire on a fixed (0.25s) cast-time delay, then go on cooldown

Soulflare adds a second, separately-timed damage instance (field rupture after a 1.5s delay) on top of the impact hit; Focused Resolve deals its damage again as a delayed aftereffect if the 2s tether is not broken

Gathering Fire (P) shortens Mantra's current cooldown by 4s per enemy champion hit by a Karma damaging ability (Q's two instances, and W's two instances, each count separately), letting Mantra recharge faster the more the dummy is hit
Mana costs (40-80 on Q, 50-70 on W, 60-80 on E) are meaningful relative to Karma's mana pool and can limit how many casts fit in the 15s window
Inspire/Defiance shield and Renewal's self-heal only matter for damage-taken/survival, never read by the damage-only dummy fight

needsBespoke.why: Mantra (R) is a zero-cost, on-cast-cooldown-start buff that arms the NEXT BASIC ABILITY (not basic attack) cast within 8 seconds with a different bonus effect depending on which slot is cast: bonus magic damage split across two instances if spent on Q, a longer root plus a self-heal (no damage) if spent on W, or bonus shield (no damage) if spent on E. None of the closed-list primitives model 'the next ability cast, whichever it is, gets a slot-dependent bonus effect'; empowered-attack/nth-hit-or-cast are built around basic attacks, and weapon-or-ammo-system assumes stacking ammo rather than a single decaying charge that can be aimed at any of three different spells with three different effect types. The simulator needs bespoke logic: hold one Mantra charge, decay it after 8s if unused, and apply its Q-specific bonus-damage terms (RQImpactDamage, RQFieldDamage) only when the charge is consumed on Q.

unsettled.question: Does KarmaMantra#RWHealAmount ((17 + 0.01xAP) * 0.01) actually scale with Mantra's rank, or is it a flat 17%(+1%/100AP) missing-health heal at every Mantra rank?
options: Flat formula regardless of Mantra rank, as the single bin formula (no rank bracket) suggests
Scales by rank the way other Mantra bonuses do (per the wiki's general 'Renewal scales with Mantra rank' claim), with per-rank base values that neither source tabulates numerically

unsettled.question: Is Mantra's 8-second empowerment window (how long the 'next ability empowered' buff lasts before expiring unused) a value the sim should trust from the wiki text alone, given no bin field carries this timer?
options: Treat it as unconfirmed/unsourced from the bin and flag it as an assumption in the rotation model
quotes: '''Karma''' empowers her next basic ability within 8 seconds for an additional effect.

unsettled.question: When a Mantra-empowered Soulflare and a plain Inner Flame both hit the single dummy, does Gathering Fire count each of Soulflare's two damage instances (impact + field) as a separate 'hit' for its own 4s Mantra-CDR tick (i.e. 8s total per Soulflare cast), or does one champion hit only ever grant a single 4s reduction per ability cast regardless of how many damage instances it produces?
options: Each damage instance (impact, field) grants its own 4s reduction, matching the wiki's explicit 'if 5 enemy champions are hit by both instances of damage' cap of 4*10=40s math
Only one 4s reduction per ability cast per champion, and the 'both instances' wording refers only to counting across 5 champions, not doubling on a single target
quotes: {{ai|Inner Flame|Karma}} / {{ai|Soulflare|Karma}} reduces {{ais|Mantra|Karma}} cooldown per champion hit by either damage instance (up to a maximum total reduction of {{ap|4*10}} seconds if 5 enemy champions are hit by both instances of damage).

proposal: Before or at the start of the fight, cast Mantra (R) to arm the empowerment (it costs no mana, so casting it early wastes nothing).

Immediately cast Q (consuming the Mantra charge to fire Soulflare) into the dummy: this lands the base impact damage plus the Mantra impact bonus, then the field ruptures ~1.5s later for the field bonus damage.
Cast W (Focused Resolve) on the dummy for its initial damage; hold the tether uninterrupted so its aftereffect damage fires automatically ~2s later.
Recast Q on cooldown (down to 5s at max rank) as the primary repeated damage source for the rest of the fight.
Recast W every time it comes off cooldown (12s, does not reduce with rank) to add its two-instance damage again.

Recast Mantra the instant it comes off cooldown (it shortens further from Gathering Fire's per-hit CDR) and always spend the resulting charge on the next Q cast, never on W or E, since only Q's Mantra bonus deals damage.
Do not cast E in the damage fight (Inspire/Defiance deals no damage and is a mana cost with no offensive return against a stationary target).
questions: Should Mantra be reserved strictly for Q every time, or is there ever a reason to let a charge expire unused (e.g., to guarantee W's root/heal utility) that the sim should still model even though it doesn't add damage?

Given Karma's relatively low base mana pool and the costs on Q/W/E, what level/item mana assumptions should the sim use to decide how many casts of each ability actually fit in the 15s window before Karma runs out of mana?

Does the sim need to account for Mantra's cooldown starting on cast (cdstart = on-cast) when deciding exactly how early to first cast R relative to the first Q, or is 'cast R then immediately Q' always optimal regardless of timing details?

Should Focused Resolve's aftereffect (second damage tick ~2s after cast) be scheduled as a fixed delayed event in the kill-time calculation, given the tether is guaranteed to complete against a stationary, non-fleeing dummy?
